description: The SQL database operations every language executes. Each operation has one logical result and backend-specific SQL where database dialects differ.

operations.name: statement
operations.description: Runs a direct query and verifies that it returns one true value.

operations.name: prepared_statement
operations.description: Binds an integer to a prepared query that must return no rows.

sql.mariadb: SELECT name FROM conformance.items WHERE id = ${id}
sql.postgresql: SELECT name FROM conformance.items WHERE id = ${id}

operations.name: batch
operations.description: Executes two inserts as one batch and verifies that both statements succeed.

operations.name: stored_procedure
operations.description: Calls the no-op stored procedure and verifies that it returns no result sets.
